title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Role Description

We’re looking for a responsible, empathetic, and detail-oriented Customer Support and Success Representative to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for our customers via email, phone, and social media platforms. In addition to managing customer communications, you will help collect and manage feedback from customers to continually improve our operations. You will also support key interdepartmental company tasks to help ensure a smooth and engaging online experience.


Role Responsibilities

Customer Support:

  • Provide exceptional customer experience via email, social media, and by phone.

Customer Success :

  • Work with the Marketing team to manage customer feedback in organized surveys
  • Monitor social media for trends and customer feedback


Digital, E-commerce, and other Operations:

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.


Headshots.com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.


The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.


Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.


CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.


Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.


Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.


Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Product Manager - B2B | Câmbio / FX
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!


Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Buscamos um(a) Product Manager estratégico, analítico e comunicativo, capaz de conectar produto, tecnologia e negócio para impulsionar nossas soluções. Esperamos alguém que tenha uma execução ágil e organizada, garantindo qualidade e rapidez, além de autonomia para conduzir upstream e gerenciar o backlog sem necessidade de direcionamento constante. E que possua forte capacidade analítica para tomar decisões embasadas, comunicação clara para alinhar stakeholders e um sólido senso de responsabilidade e equilíbrio na tomada de decisões.

  • Experiência com descoberta e desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Domínio de métricas, KPIs e análise de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade de priorizar backlog e rodar sprints com eficiência;
  • Conhecimento de estratégia de produto e roadmap;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão como JIRA, Kanbanize e Confluence;
  • Noção de tecnologia e APIs para dialogar bem com times de engenharia;
  • Experiência em produtos financeiros, especialmente câmbio;
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos e de alto crescimento;
  • Habilidade em negociação e influência para conectar áreas e garantir entregas estratégicas;
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência como Product Manager.


O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Experiência com setor de câmbio;

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Data Analyst & Operations Manager
description:
Data Analyst & Operations Manager


We're looking for a motivated data driven person who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. This position is available remote in Brazil.


  • You solve problems by connecting your holistic business knowledge, marketing understanding and deep dive analytical abilities
  • You are our truffle hunter, who quickly finds smart and pragmatic ways through complex datasets and recognises patterns in business KPIs and marketing channels
  • You autonomously realize projects in cooperation with other colleagues as well as with marketing channels which serve the management as a strategic decision-making basis for growth and excellence
  • You filter growth relevant information from our BI/tracking systems and convert complexity into simplicity
  • You find strategies to automate marketing campaigns, improve targeting and drive marketing efficiency
  • You monitor business relevant KPIs on a regular basis and find new ways for automated reporting systems
  • You monitor business supply chain on a regular basis to ensure our stock is up to our potential sales


  • Degree in Engineering, TI, Business Informatics, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar
  • Strong analytical skills: able to break down problems, test hypotheses, track the impact of solutions on the respective problems.
  • Great experience with tools such as Excel and PowerBI or similar
  • Know-how in Google Analytics is nice to have
  • Know-how in Facebook Ads is nice to have
  • Know-how in segmentation is nice to have
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; every other European language is a plus


  • You have an impact. With innovation and smart technology, we create comfy sustainable shoes and digital assets for the future generations. We want your ideas and give you autonomy to make them reality.
  • At Undo For Tomorrow we are flexible. Organize your own schedule, and balance work between the office and home as it’s best for you. We give you trust-based hours and a flexible smart working policy.
  • Teamwork makes the dream work. Our team has people from 3 different continents. We work in a multicultural environment where we can challenge and support each other.
  • We’re building for the long term, and that means protecting our planet. We constantly test new green technologies and new opportunities, both physical and digital.


We are a Brazilian / European footwear startup with headquarters in Lisbon preparing to sell globally. We started not so long ago (2021) and we are growing fast with many challenges and new market opportunities to unlock.

We believe that innovation and technology allied to sustainability is key to success in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. Our goal is to bring comfort and well being to our growing community.

Our journey has just begun. Are you ready to join us and help shape the future?

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.


Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já construiu ambientes e entendesse de conceitos de rede e protocolos de comunicação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tunning de aplicações.
  • Escrevesse em linguagem de script.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.
  • Incessante na aprendizagem.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Evoluir e otimizar soluções existentes, sempre garantindo alta escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Qualidade de Código: Implementar e promover práticas de testes rigorosos para assegurar a qualidade do software.
  • Colaboração em Requisitos: Trabalhar diretamente com usuários para compreender e documentar requisitos, e colaborar com a equipe no processo de implementação, desde o código até a produção.
  • Investigação de Problemas: Auxiliar na análise e resolução de falhas potenciais em sistemas e processos, garantindo a estabilidade e a eficácia da operação.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Customer Support and Success Representative
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a responsible, empathetic, and detail-oriented Customer Support and Success Representative to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for our customers via email, phone, and social media platforms. In addition to managing customer communications, you will help collect and manage feedback from customers to continually improve our operations. You will also support key interdepartmental company tasks to help ensure a smooth and engaging online experience.


Role Responsibilities

Customer Support:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, feedback, and support requests.
  • Provide exceptional customer experience via email, social media, and by phone.
  • Communicate with the manufacturing team to ensure customer requests are handled with quality.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for wholesale customers.


Customer Success :

  • Collect and relay customer feedback to help shape product improvements.
  • Present reports based on customer inquiries and comments received by email and phone
  • Work with the Marketing team to manage customer feedback in organized surveys
  • Monitor social media for trends and customer feedback


Digital, E-commerce, and other Operations:

  • Ensure the website is functioning correctly and troubleshoot any issues that arise.
  • Execute digital operations audits and processes
  • Manage and update various Google Sheets used for project tracking.
  • Assist interdepartmental projects 
  • Other duties as assigned 


Qualifications
  • Full fluency in both written and spoken English is required. Candidates without this qualification will not be considered for this role .
  • Associate's or Bachelor’s degree
  • A customer-first mindset
  • Previous experience in customer-facing roles with phone support is a bonus
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Experience with phone support platforms such as Zendesk or CallHippo is a plus
  • Experience working with Google Sheets
  • Ability to learn quickly and a strong willingness to continuously develop new skills


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

• Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.

• Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.

• Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.

• Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.

• Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.

• Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.

• Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.

• Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.

• Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

﻿

How to Apply

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:
Curte garantir qualidade em sistemas que realmente fazem a operação acontecer?

Como Analista de QA, você será peça-chave na estabilidade e evolução de soluções ERP, assegurando que cada entrega funcione com precisão, performance e confiabilidade.


Aqui, qualidade não é só testar — é entender o negócio, antecipar riscos e garantir uma experiência sólida para o usuário final.


Responsabilidades

Planejar e executar testes funcionais e não funcionais em sistemas ERP

Criar e manter roteiros de testes (manuais e automatizados)

Desenvolver automações de testes utilizando Selenium

Validar integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços, etc.)

Executar consultas em banco de dados (SQL) para validação de dados

Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs até a resolução

Atuar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e produto

Participar de refinamentos, garantindo critérios de aceite claros

Contribuir para melhoria contínua da qualidade e processos

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência como QA/Testes em sistemas ERP ou sistemas complexos

Conhecimento sólido em testes funcionais e regressivos

Experiência com Selenium (automação de testes)

Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados

Experiência com documentação de testes e gestão de bugs

Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

Conhecimento em CI/CD (pipeline de testes automatizados)

Experiência com testes em sistemas financeiros ou operacionais

Noções de performance e testes de carga

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
  • 12-month contract with potential extensions


Job Description:

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing AI and data engineering team focused on building production‑ready AI products. This role sits at the intersection of data/ML pipelines, MLOps, and applied generative AI, supporting initiatives such as forecasting, inventory intelligence, and conversational/agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands‑on, comfortable moving from prototype to production, and excited about building scalable ML/AI systems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data and machine learning pipelines to support AI‑driven products and analytics. Develop and productionize LLM‑based solutions, including conversational and agentic AI use cases. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows. Collaborate on AI prototyping efforts, rapidly validating ideas and transitioning successful prototypes into production systems. Work with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to support AI workflows and automation. Support initiatives related to forecasting and inventory intelligence, including contributions to a unified UI that explains what forecasts are and why they are generated. Partner closely with data engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business‑facing AI solutions. Contribute to cloud‑based architectures, with exposure to Azure (primary) and GCP (emerging footprint) as part of an upcoming cloud migration.



Required Skills:

- 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering

- Strong experience with Python for data and machine learning development.

- Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and pipeline development.

- Hands‑on experience building data/ML pipelines (minimum baseline expectation).

- Solid understanding of MLOps, including CI/CD practices for ML systems.

- Experience working with LLMs and modern AI tooling (e.g., ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs).

- Familiarity with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration of AI workflows.

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCP


Compensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

description:
Pay: 10k-13.5k Brazilian Reals per Month

Title: Travel OT Generalis

Location: Brazil (70% travel)

Openings: 1

Start date: ASAP


Must Have:

  • 3+ years in an OT (industrial) environment within IT functions - Technical knowledge of OT systems and infrastructure
  • Specialization in at least one OT area
  • Versatility in OT tasks
  • Cybersecurity knowledge
  • Must be able to travel at least 70% of the time


Job Description:

The OT Generalist is a versatile role responsible for a wide range of tasks within the operational technology environment. This includes conducting health reviews, evaluating server infrastructure, creating domain controllers, and working with the network engineer to do on-site network configuration and troubleshooting. The OT Generalist will also be involved in creating and managing OU structures, GPOs, and DNS reverse lookup zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • On-Site cutover of systems.
  • Conduct secondary health reviews of domains.
  • Evaluate server infrastructure capacity and request quotes for new equipment if needed.
  • Create and configure domain controllers and trusts.
  • Manage OU structures, GPOs, and Sites and Services.
  • Create and connect process machines to appropriate domains.
  • Ensure proper patching and security tool setup for all machines.
  • Specialize in at least one area of OT to provide deep expertise when needed.
  • Install and configure security tools as needed.

description:

Location: Remote in LATAM – Brazil (Work primarily in local time zone with overlap across US, India, and UK teams)

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager .


In this role you will:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment.

  • Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors).
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.g., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence).
  • Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment).
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA).
  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.


We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.).

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais Responsabilidades

Responsabilidade: Desenvolvedor é responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps, garantindo processos automatizados e seguros para compilação, teste e entrega de software. Além disso, será responsável pela criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens de contêiner, assegurando atualizações regulares e correções de vulnerabilidades, e pela criação de templates base para projetos em React e .NET, promovendo padronização, qualidade e eficiência no ciclo de desenvolvimento.Também deverá gerenciar o Azure DevOps, especialmente no uso e configuração do Azure Boards, criando projetos, times e workflows ágeis que suportem o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software da organização.


Requisitos técnicos:

• Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts e Boards).

• Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD.

• Gerenciamento do Azure Boards (criação de projetos, times, workflows, sprints e dashboards).

• Criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens base.

• Gestão de vulnerabilidades em containers e imagens.

• Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM).

• Conhecimento em .NET e React.

• Versionamento de código (Git).

• Automação de builds e releases.

• Monitoramento e integração de qualidade de código (SonarQube, CodeQL).

Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

description:

Garantir a qualidade funcional das entregas, assegurando que os fluxos de negócio estejam corretos, bem testados e devidamente rastreados.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Vivência com APIs e microserviços
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Postman ou Insomnia
  • Conhecimento em Jira e Xray
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos
  • Boa capacidade de documentação e escrita de cenários

  • Noções de automação (JavaScript / Playwright)
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki)
  • Experiência com meios de pagamento

  • Noções de segurança (PCI, dados sensíveis)

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;

title: CRO & Marketing Specialist (UX, Content Writing)
description:
Company Description

We are Charly, a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who is passionate about websites, data, and improving performance. This role will focus on analyzing user behavior, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing structured experimentation to improve lead generation and sales performance across our client projects.

You will work closely with our Project Managers, designers, developers, and leadership team to ensure that the websites we build are not only visually strong but also optimized to convert.


Your Core Responsibilities

  • Conduct CRO audits for client websites and landing pages to identify friction points, funnel drop-offs, and conversion barriers
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, heatmaps, and session recordings
  • Identify issues related to checkout abandonment, form drop-offs, mobile UX problems, trust gaps, and messaging clarity
  • Design and implement structured A/B or multivariate experiments to improve conversion performance
  • Optimize key elements including headlines, CTAs, layouts, forms, product pages, and landing pages
  • Prepare structured audit reports with prioritized recommendations based on potential revenue impact
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and PMs to implement CRO improvements across active client projects
  • Join client and sales calls when necessary to explain CRO strategies, findings, and experiment results in clear, non-technical language
  • Continuously refine optimization strategies as new data and experiment results become available


Who this role is perfect for:

  • Someone with strong analytical thinking who can translate data into clear action steps
  • Someone who understands both UX and marketing psychology behind conversions
  • Someone comfortable running experiments and interpreting results
  • Someone who enjoys working with websites, funnels, and digital products
  • Someone proactive who can identify improvement opportunities without waiting for direction

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um profissional com sólida experiência em automação e qualidade de software. Procuramos alguém tecnicamente forte em Playwright, testes de front-end e API, e familiarizado com práticas modernas de QA, como shift-left testing e Gherkin.

Se você gosta de evoluir frameworks de automação e contribuir para a cultura de qualidade de múltiplas squads, esta vaga é para você.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


O que você irá fazer:

* Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados (foco em APIs e serviços/microserviços).

* Especificar e implementar cenários seguindo BDD com Gherkin.

* Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Xray (Gherkin).

* Garantir cobertura e eficácia com técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Integrar automação aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins), garantindo execução recorrente e confiável.

* Realizar smoke testing e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.

* Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) quando aplicável.

* Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações para qualidade ponta a ponta.

* Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes de teste e execução de pipelines automatizados.

* Apoiar investigação de falhas utilizando observabilidade (traces/métricas/logs), quando necessário.


O que esperamos de você:

* Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação).

* Experiência com Gherkin (BDD) e uso do Xray com Gherkin.

* Profundo entendimento de APIs (validação de payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, etc.).

* Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins).

* Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.

* Familiaridade com testes em ambientes distribuídos / microserviços.

* Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Vivência com smoke testing.

* Programação (principalmente JavaScript) — obrigatório e eliminatório.


Desejável:

* Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e tópicos de mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento).

* Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting básico de execuções (logs/health checks).

* Experiência com observabilidade (Dynatrace / OpenTelemetry / Grafana Loki) para diagnóstico e redução de testes instáveis (“flaky tests”).

* Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.

* Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

* Noções de Terraform (para entendimento de ambientes e limitações de infraestrutura).



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

description:
SAP FI Specialist

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.

Trabalho: Remoto
